Before you call

Common questions

A few useful starting points. For a price or timeline, the roof itself has the final say.

Do you work outside Brandon?

McCallum serves residential, commercial and industrial clients in Manitoba, specifically Brandon and area. Include the property address in the quote form so the office can confirm service.

What should I include in a quote request?

Your phone number, the property address, the type of building, and a short description of the roof: age if you know it, active leaks, damaged shingles, or the work you are planning.

Can you look at a leak before recommending replacement?

Roof repair and service is one of McCallum’s core services. Describe where the leak shows up and when it happens, and the office can advise on the next step.

Do you handle commercial flat roofs?

Yes. Flat roof installation and replacement is listed among McCallum’s core services for commercial and industrial buildings.
